notes.title: Venineth is ready to roll! New gameplay trailer & release date announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi!

As you well know, the original release date was set for the year 4019. By employing hyper-modern QA AI, we were able to move this date a little closer...

But seriously, after over four years of work (after hours), the game is already finished. We make the final touches, correct bugs, make some changes and optional facilitations, thanks to which the game will be friendly also for more casual players (more info soon).

We are happy to announce that the current and unchanging release date is 
[b][h3]ːsummer2019flagːApril 16, 2020ːsummer2019flagː[/h3][/b]
7 days!

On this occasion we have prepared a trailer:

[previewyoutube=GfwYnv75LM0;full][/previewyoutube]

We also want to announce that we partnered with the publisher - Monad Rock, which helps us with testing, patching, marketing, and console port... other stuff ;)

We hope that the cooperation will be fruitful and not end with just this one title!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/976500/ss_bb5b809919296b6a804f96d2cb4496b405292063.1920x1080.jpg[/img]

We are preparing a free demo version which will be available for download on Steam in the future.

See you [strike]in 4019[/strike] next week!

Venineth Team
And
Monad Rock Team

notes.title: Open Beta update v0.0818 changelog & current state of the project.
notes.notes:
Thanks for all criticism, ideas and bugs reporting, we receive from you in the comments and e-mails.

[b]Download beta:[/b]
[url=https://venineth-team.itch.io/venineth-beta]itch[/url]
[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/venineth/434639]gamejolt[/url]

[b]Update v0.0818 changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]optimization:
        - SSR optimization - performance improvement (especially in the last level),

[*]bugfixing:
        - invisible walls placement corrections,  
        - graphics glitches corrections,
        - fixes of several places where the player could get stuck, 

[*]other:
        - minor level design tweaks,
        - Guide Probe now flies into the Capsule,
        - more checkpoints in difficult places,
        - reduction of film grain effect intensity,
[/list] 
    No changes in UI /options at the moment, but we are working on it. For now we're focusing on the rest of the game.

[b]Current state of the project:[/b]

We're close to finish all levels in the beta state,  more than 20 levels, that means 5-10 hours of gameplay in total. Huge amount of work, too huge for just  two devs... but we can do it!​ Thank you for your patience!
